results.title: A Thermal Imaging Dataset for Fruit Bruise Detection and Classification
results.description: This dataset contains thermal images of fruits for automated bruise detection and classification tasks using deep learning methods. The dataset includes two fruit types: apple and tomato, each categorized into bruised and healthy classes.

results.title: Early Bruise Detection in Apple Based on an Improved Faster RCNN Model
results.description: To evaluate the effectiveness of early bruise detection by SWIR bands compared to the visible/near-infrared (Vis/NIR) bands, a hybrid dataset with images from two cameras with different bands was used for validation. To improve the accuracy of the model in detecting apple bruises, calyxes, and stems, several improvements are implemented.
